message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Insider Net Buying Ratio", "construction": "Sum of insider purchases minus insider sales over the past 6 months, divided by shares outstanding, using SEC Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "Insider buying may reflect superior information about future firm prospects, suggesting undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Intensity", "construction": "Number of new patents granted to the firm in the past year, divided by total assets at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Firms with greater innovative output may be better positioned for future growth and profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Percentage change in total number of employees reported in annual reports over the past year.", "rationale": "Rapid hiring may signal expanding business operations and anticipated revenue growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt Change", "construction": "Change in short-term debt (current liabilities minus current assets) from previous year, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Significant reductions in short-term debt may indicate improving financial health and lower distress risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Accumulation Ratio", "construction": "Annual change in inventories divided by net sales over the same period.", "rationale": "Rising inventories relative to sales may signal demand shortfalls or inefficient operations.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "A binary variable equal to 1 if the firm has omitted its dividend in the past year, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend omissions may indicate temporary distress and create opportunities for mean reversion.", "higher_returns_for": "high values (firms that omitted dividends)"}, {"name": "Segment Diversification Index", "construction": "Number of distinct business segments (as reported in annual reports), divided by total firm assets.", "rationale": "Greater diversification may reduce risk, attract investors, or reflect managerial skill.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D to Market Cap", "construction": "Annual research and development expenditures divided by market capitalization at year-end.", "rationale": "High R&D spending relative to size may signal overlooked growth opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "Number of years the current CEO has held the position, as reported in proxy statements.", "rationale": "Longer-tenured CEOs may have developed superior firm-specific knowledge, or alternatively, stagnation; the effect direction is an empirical question.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Pre-Tax Profit Margin Stability", "construction": "Standard deviation of pre-tax profit margin (EBIT divided by sales) over the prior five years.", "rationale": "Firms with more stable margins may be less risky and thus attract investors.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
